portion_doctrine: Segments 101-110 are video tutorial transcripts from Adobe Premier Pro/Lightroom color grading masterclass. The content is primarily educational dialogue about color correction and grading techniques. ~90% is boilerplate tutorial narration with minimal actionable doctrine. No structured frameworks, formulas, or novel operating rules extracted.
operating_rules: Color correction: Fix exposed/problematic images (treat correction as fixing something broken)
Color grading: Build on an image (extract more, enhance aesthetically)
Basic Correction tab: First tool for manual color grading workflow
S-curve strategy: Key curves grading technique for non-flat image enhancement
Adjustment layer workflow: More efficient than individual clip color correction
Toggle on/off: Always verify effect by toggling to see before/after difference
Log/flat footage: Records with flat picture profile, gives more grading information to work with
tools: Adobe Premier Pro color correction tab
Basic Correction adjustments: exposure, contrast, highlights, whites, blacks, shadows
weird_gold: S-curve is 'self-explanatory' but narrator walks through it step-by-step: drag down then up creating S shape for contrast/depth
Overexposure definition provided: 'when the light is overwhelmingly overexposing the scene'
Anti-exposure strategy: bump down whites, bump up blacks (inverse of normal brightness adjustment)
